order_rule: replace removed slot, preserve all other positions
tie_rule: exact E numerator; radius within 1e-12; mean within 1e-12; added then removed lexicographic ID

original_geometry_settings.action_scale: MAD*1.4826; then IQR/1.349; then range; then 1
original_geometry_settings.distance_scale: median strictly positive calibration distances, or 1 if all zero
original_geometry_settings.center: minimum mean combined distance to seeded reference subset
original_geometry_settings.tie_break: lexicographic filename; absolute float64 tie tolerance 1e-12
